in_sanskrit.name: सौरवि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sauravi is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sau' meaning 'sun' and 'Ravi' meaning 'brilliance'. The name signifies the brilliance and radiance of the sun.

in_hindi.name: सौरवि
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sauravi in Hindi translates to 'the radiance of the sun'. It is pronounced as [sauravi].

in_tamil.name: Sauravi
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Gentle flow of the sun
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sauravi ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। The gentle flow of the sun, representing the calming and nurturing aspect of the sun

in_telugu.name: Sauravi
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Gentle flow of the sun
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sauravi ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। The gentle flow of the sun, representing the calming and nurturing aspect of the sun

in_marathi.name: Sauravi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gentle flow of the sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sauravi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The gentle flow of the sun, representing the calming and nurturing aspect of the sun

in_bengali.name: Sauravi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Gentle flow of the sun
